editorial.blurb: Akahoshi Ramen delivers deeply layered, umami-rich bowls that have earned devoted loyalty and comparison to Tokyo's finest.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Akahoshi Miso as your first bowl to experience their signature richness, ask for extra ramen eggs (they're packed with flavor and have an amazing jammy texture), and check for seasonal specials like the cumin lamb aburasoba.
